nl_query: Show me total revenue by region
expected_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM public.sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

nl_query: How many customers do we have in each country?
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM public.customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC

nl_query: List all orders from the last 30 days
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM public.orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY order_date DESC

nl_query: Show me monthly revenue for 2025
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM public.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

nl_query: Show customer names with their total order amounts
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_orders FROM public.customers c JOIN public.orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_orders DESC

nl_query: Which products have revenue greater than $100,000?
expected_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM public.sales GROUP BY product_name HAVING SUM(revenue) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

nl_query: What was the week-over-week growth in signups?
expected_sql: SELECT week, signups, LAG(signups) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS prev_week_signups, ROUND((signups - LAG(signups) OVER (ORDER BY week)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(signups) OVER (ORDER BY week), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', signup_date) AS week, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM public.users GROUP BY week) sub ORDER BY week

nl_query: Show the top 10 customers by lifetime value
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, SUM(order_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM public.orders GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 10

nl_query: Find customers who have placed orders above the average order value
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM public.customers c JOIN public.orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM public.orders) ORDER BY c.name

nl_query: Calculate the month-over-month revenue growth rate
expected_sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM public.transactions GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month

nl_query: What is the average order value?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_value FROM public.orders

nl_query: Show me inactive users who haven't logged in for 90 days
expected_sql: SELECT id, name, email, last_login FROM public.users WHERE last_login < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' OR last_login IS NULL ORDER BY last_login ASC NULLS FIRST

nl_query: Which regions have the highest average deal size?
expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, AVG(d.amount) AS avg_deal_size FROM public.deals d JOIN public.regions r ON d.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_deal_size DESC

nl_query: Show me the revenue breakdown by product category for Q1 2025
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM public.sales s JOIN public.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

nl_query: Show the retention rate by signup cohort and month
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.signup_date) AS cohort, DATE_TRUNC('month', a.activity_date) AS activity_month, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS active_users FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.activity a ON u.id = a.user_id AND a.activity_date >= u.signup_date GROUP BY cohort, activity_month ORDER BY cohort, activity_month

nl_query: Count the number of transactions per day this week
expected_sql: SELECT DATE(transaction_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM public.transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

nl_query: Rank sales representatives by total revenue and show their region
expected_sql: SELECT sr.name, r.region_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC) AS rank FROM public.sales_representatives sr JOIN public.sales s ON sr.id = s.rep_id JOIN public.regions r ON sr.region_id = r.id GROUP BY sr.name, r.region_name ORDER BY rank

nl_query: Find all customers from Germany and France
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM public.customers WHERE country IN ('Germany', 'France') ORDER BY name

nl_query: Compare revenue this quarter vs the same quarter last year
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_q1, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_q1 FROM public.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'

nl_query: Show products that have never been purchased
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.product_name FROM public.products p WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM public.orders) ORDER BY p.product_name
